scope: Focused Host/Native launch, authority transport, state, lifecycle, return, English object contract and Android probe adapter review. This is not a complete independent audit of all 68 Host or 34 Native files.

findings.finding: The Dart launch captures and rechecks the profile lease; MainActivity routes memory/quiz only with the current 32-hex table token and live main-process authority. Native validated_options preserves the table token while retaining the Village branch and existing return/ACK functions.

Dart retains production deck/question/reward ownership. Java/Kotlin request validation and Native requests share token, roundId, revision and monotonic sequence. The private bound service guards authority; public Native state contains no unrevealed Memory motifs or Quiz correct answer.

All 36 emitted Dart view fields match Native STATE_KEYS in exact order. Nullable explanations after reveal and normalized fifty-fifty option indices are accepted by the actual published Native parser; hidden correct-answer fields remain forbidden before reveal.

The table Activity uses the existing visible lease, remote authority and pause/stop/destroy invalidation. Dart pauses on expired heartbeat or increased pause epoch. Exit waits for authority acknowledgement and the existing durable game-event write; failed persistence does not claim return success.

The Native shared safe-area reader obtains the actual Godot render View via AndroidRuntime/JavaClassWrapper on the UI thread. It does not require a missing custom method on TableGamesHostPlugin. This source consistency is not an Android inset test.

Host and Native use the same closed 14-word catalogue and German meanings, three distinct permitted objects and a target present among them. The English illustration returns to the existing Flutter learning task without submitting a graded answer/mastery result. Existing PCM and Wisp production hunks remain in the combined source.

The new shared table adapter checks candidate working directory, committed helper bytes and source identity before import, and again afterward. The game probes require real prior-tour/same-APK/PCK binding, actual private activity/PID, current rendered layout and real ADB touches. Saved deck/answer access is a declared read-only QA oracle; no seed/reset/write adapter is introduced by this merge. Individual visual algorithms were not exhaustively re-audited here.

The unchanged scripts/compile_android_host.sh invokes real Gradle Kotlin/Java compilation against the Godot Android AAR and verifies actual class-file magic/hashes for TableGameActivity, TableGamesHostPlugin, TableGamesBridge, TableAuthorityService and TableGameIntent in addition to existing Host classes.
